description: Price out emptying a chain's native gas balance to exactly zero: how much actually arrives, the full fee breakdown, and whether the balance is even large enough to be worth recovering. Returns a quote ID; quotes expire after about 60 seconds. Executing the sweep needs the wallet's signing key, which this hosted server does not hold - use the @zerodust/mcp-server package or the SDK for that.

destination.description: Destination address to receive swept funds

fromChainId.description: Source chain ID to sweep from

toChainId.description: Destination chain ID to receive funds

userAddress.description: User's wallet address to sweep from

name: zerodust_get_quote
